object.name: evi.zeroxcount~
object.digest: Like MSP <o>zerox~</o> with controls for window size and threshold, with simultaneous analysis outputs
object.description: This was built for a very specific need but might be useful as a controller. It is very similar to the RNBO 'zerox_count~' object but with simultaneous outlets for a > threshold gate and # of crossings.

inlets.description: The audio input to be analysed for zero crossings.

outlets.description: Number of zero crossings per analysis window.
Gate out, if crossings in window period > @threshold amount.

attributes.name: size
attributes.description: The size of the analysis window with which to count zero crossings in. By default this is 'vectorsize' which is a typical use case.

attributes.name: thresh
attributes.description: If count/window size is > than this threshold, report a gate event (middle outlet).
